english_and_references: I am tired. I need some rest. / I need to rest for a little while.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 告诉对方你累了，需要休息一会儿
context_and_translation: 第一句说明疲劳及休息需求；第二句强调需要休息一小会儿。

english_and_references: I would like a small room. / I want a small room, please.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 告诉酒店你想要一个小房间
context_and_translation: would like较委婉；want更直接，加入please保持礼貌。

english_and_references: I need to go now. / I have to leave now.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 告诉对方你现在需要离开
context_and_translation: need to go和have to leave在此都说明现在需要离开，后者常带必须的意味。

english_and_references: I walk every day. / I go for a walk every day.
context_and_translation: 第一句说每天步行；第二句通常指每天散步，不一定是步行通勤。

english_and_references: Can you read this message? / Please read this message.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 请求对方读一下这条消息
context_and_translation: 第一句以Can you请求读消息；第二句直接礼貌请求。

english_and_references: Can we meet at eight? / How about meeting at eight?
context_and_translation: 第一句询问八点见面是否可行；第二句以How about提出同一建议。

english_and_references: The bag is under the table. / The bag is below the table.
context_and_translation: under强调在桌子下面；below表示位置较低，实际遮挡关系可结合指物说明。

english_and_references: Is the station near here? / Is the station close to here?
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 询问车站离这里近不近
context_and_translation: near和close to在这里都表示距离近，注意close后接to。

english_and_references: I need two tickets. / Can I have two tickets, please?
context_and_translation: 第一句说明需要两张票；第二句礼貌地请求两张票。

english_and_references: How much are these two things? / What is the price for both?
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 询问这两个东西总共多少钱
context_and_translation: 第一句直接问两个物品总价；第二句用both表示这两个，未询问单件价格。

english_and_references: Can I pay in cash? / Can I use cash to pay?
context_and_translation: pay in cash和use cash to pay都表示现金付款。

english_and_references: I do not understand. / I cannot understand this.
context_and_translation: 第一句说明不明白；第二句加this指出不理解的当前内容。

english_and_references: Can you speak slowly, please? / Please speak more slowly.
context_and_translation: 第一句以Can you请求慢说；第二句用more slowly要求比刚才再慢一些。

english_and_references: I am sick. I need a doctor. / Can you help me find a doctor?
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 身体不舒服，请求帮助找医生
context_and_translation: 第一句说明身体不适及找医生的需求；第二句直接请求帮助找到医生。

english_and_references: This is my father. / That person is my father.
context_and_translation: this和that通常分别指近处与较远处；请按照实际指向选择。

english_and_references: May I use your phone to call my family? / Can I call my family on your phone?
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 询问能否用电话联系家人
context_and_translation: May I较正式礼貌；Can I也常用于请求许可，两句都借电话联系家人。

english_and_references: My sister is at home. / My sister is home.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 告诉对方你的姐妹在家
context_and_translation: at home和home在这两句中都表示在家，指同一个姐妹。

english_and_references: Can I have a cup of water, please? / I would like a cup of water, please.
context_and_translation: Can I have提出请求；I would like礼貌表达想要一杯水。

english_and_references: Please use less sugar. / Can you put in less sugar?
context_and_translation: 第一句直接请求少放糖；第二句以Can you提出同一请求。

english_and_references: No milk in my tea, please. / Please do not put milk in my tea.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 告诉对方你的茶里不要加牛奶
context_and_translation: 第一句是自然的简短点单表达；第二句用完整请求说明不要加奶。

english_and_references: I will go there by bus. / I will take a bus there.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 说你会坐公交车去那里
context_and_translation: 第一句用by bus说明方式；第二句用take a bus说明乘车动作。

english_and_references: Where can I buy a ticket? / Where can I get a ticket?
context_and_translation: buy明确问购票处；get也可表示拿到票，售票语境中通常能理解为购票。

english_and_references: I cannot find my room key. / I do not know where my room key is.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 在酒店说明房间钥匙找不到了
context_and_translation: 第一句说找不到房间钥匙；第二句说明不知道它在哪里，不推断丢失原因。

english_and_references: Where can I wait? / Is there a place where I can wait?
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 在机场询问可以在哪里等
context_and_translation: 第一句直接问哪里能等；第二句询问是否有可等待的地方。

english_and_references: How many do you need? / How many would you like?
context_and_translation: 第一句问需要多少；第二句问想要多少，意愿和必要数量可能不同，可继续确认。

english_and_references: I need a little more time. / Can you give me a little more time?
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 工作中说明你需要多一点时间
context_and_translation: 第一句说明需要更多时间；第二句直接请对方多给一点时间。

context_and_translation: want直接表达意愿；would like更委婉。替换练习以当前选中的中文和例句为准。

english_and_references: This is too expensive. / The price is too high.
context_and_translation: 第一句用expensive描述物品；第二句用price is high说明价格高。

english_and_references: Please check the price. / Can you check the price, please?
context_and_translation: 第一句直接礼貌请求核价；第二句用Can you提问式请求。

english_and_references: It is a thing for opening doors. / You use it to open a door.
context_and_translation: 第一句说明用途；第二句从使用者动作说明。替换后的意思以上方中文为准。

english_and_references: I need a piece of paper that shows how much I paid. / Please give me a piece of paper showing how much I paid.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 不会说“收据”：请用简单英语说明，你需要一张纸，显示你付了多少钱。
context_and_translation: 两句都请求显示已付款金额的纸质记录，第二句是较直接的礼貌请求。

english_and_references: Where is the thing that takes people up and down between floors? / I need to go up. Where is the thing that takes people to other floors?
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 不会说“电梯”：说明你要找一个能在楼层之间载人的房间一样的东西。
context_and_translation: 第一句通过楼层之间载人的用途解释；第二句先说想上楼，再说明要找的东西。

english_and_references: I want to book a room now for tomorrow. / Can you keep a room for me for tomorrow?
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 不会说“预订”：说明你想现在订好房间，明天入住。
context_and_translation: 第一句用book预订明天的房间；第二句请求对方为你留一间房。

english_and_references: This food makes me sick. I cannot eat it. / I cannot eat this food because it makes me sick.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 不会说“过敏”：说明某种食物会让你生病，你不能吃它。
context_and_translation: 这是用普通英语说明不能吃及身体反应的练习，不是医学诊断。“过敏”涉及安全时可直接出示 allergy 这个词并请求专业帮助。 | 两句都说明某种食物会让你不舒服、不能吃；描述现象不等于确认医学上的过敏诊断。

english_and_references: I need something to give my phone power. / My phone needs power. Do you have something I can use?
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 不会说“充电器”：说明你需要给手机补充电力的东西。
context_and_translation: 第一句请求能给手机补电的东西；第二句先说明情况，再请对方提供可用物品。

english_and_references: Where can I buy medicine? / Is there a shop here that sells medicine?
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 不会说“药店”：询问哪里可以买药。
context_and_translation: 第一句直接问哪里买药；第二句用销售药品的商店来解释。

english_and_references: I want food with no meat or fish. / Please give me food without meat or fish.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 不会说“素食”：说明你想要不含肉或鱼的食物。
context_and_translation: 两句都说明不要肉和鱼；with no与without在这里表达同一限制。

english_and_references: The bus will be late. It will not get here on time. / The bus will not arrive on time. It will be late.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 不会说“延误”：说明公交车会比原计划晚到。
context_and_translation: 两句都说明公交车晚到、不能按时到达，仅调整说明顺序。

english_and_references: I am a teacher. / I work as a teacher.
context_and_translation: 第一句直接说明职业，第二句强调从事的工作；意思相近。

english_and_references: I am going to the station. / I am on my way to the station.
context_and_translation: 第一句说明目的地，第二句强调已在前往的途中；请按实际情况选择。

english_and_references: Why is the shop closed? / Can you tell me why the shop is closed?
context_and_translation: 第一句直接问原因，第二句以请对方告诉你的方式更委婉地问。

english_and_references: I need help because I am lost. / I am lost. Can you help me?
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 说明你迷路了，需要帮助。
context_and_translation: 第一句说明需求及原因，第二句先说明情况，再直接请求帮助。

english_and_references: I do not know this word. / This word is new to me.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 告诉对方你不认识这个词。
context_and_translation: 第一句直接说明不认识；第二句说明这个词对你是新的，并非说它刚被创造。

english_and_references: I do not understand this rule. / Can you explain this rule to me?
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 说明你不明白这条规则。
context_and_translation: 第一句说明不理解，第二句提出解释的请求；两者都能帮助继续交流。

english_and_references: I like to walk. / I like walking.
context_and_translation: 两句都自然地表示喜欢步行；这里不要求学习复杂语法名称。

english_and_references: I do not like coffee. / Coffee is not something I like.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 告诉对方你不喜欢咖啡。
context_and_translation: 第一句最简洁；第二句换一个组织方式，仍表达不喜欢，而不是过敏或不能喝。

english_and_references: I think we need more time. / I believe we need more time.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 表达你的看法：我们需要更多时间。
context_and_translation: 两句都表达个人看法；believe在这里可比think显得更确定一些。

english_and_references: Can you help me carry this bag? / Can you give me a hand with this bag?
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 请求别人帮你提这个包。
context_and_translation: 第一句明确说提包；第二句用give me a hand这个常用组合请求帮忙，不是索要一只手。

english_and_references: How long does the trip take? / How much time does the trip take?
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 询问这段旅程需要多久。
context_and_translation: 两句都问耗时，第一句更简短；不是询问几点出发。

english_and_references: How far is the hotel from here? / What is the distance from here to the hotel?
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 询问酒店离这里有多远。
context_and_translation: 第一句更简洁常用；第二句用distance这个名词表达同一个距离问题。

english_and_references: How do I use this machine? / Can you show me how to use this machine?
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 请对方说明这台机器怎么用。
context_and_translation: 第一句询问方法；第二句请求对方演示，不只是口头解释。

english_and_references: My key does not open the door. / My room key does not work.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 在酒店说明钥匙打不开房门。
context_and_translation: 第一句说出不能开门的现象；第二句说明房间钥匙无效，并不确定具体故障原因。

english_and_references: Is there a socket in the room? / Does the room have a power socket?
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 询问房间里有没有插座。
context_and_translation: 两句都询问房间设施，power socket明确指电源插座。

english_and_references: How many tickets do you have? / What is the number of tickets you have?
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 问对方现在有多少张票。
context_and_translation: 第一句简短自然；第二句较正式但正确。这里问现有票数，不是想买的数量。

english_and_references: You use it to open a door. / It is for opening doors.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 解释一把钥匙的用途：用它来开门。
context_and_translation: 第一句说明人怎样使用它，第二句说明用途；it要结合眼前物品或上下文理解。

english_and_references: It is a person who teaches students. / It is someone who helps students learn.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 忘了“教师”这个词，用简单英语描述教学生的人。
context_and_translation: 第一句直接描述教学工作；第二句说明帮助学生学习，描述范围较宽。

english_and_references: It is a place where you can borrow books. / You can go there to read books and borrow them.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 忘了“图书馆”：描述一个可以借书的地方。
context_and_translation: 第一句通过借书说明场所；第二句补充在那里读书。这里只描述通常提供借书服务的图书馆。

english_and_references: I would like another room instead. / Can I change to a different room?
context_and_translation: 第一句提出替代选择，第二句请求换房；不保证酒店一定有空房。

english_and_references: If you need help, please call me. / Please call me if you need help.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 告诉朋友：如果需要帮助，请给你打电话。
context_and_translation: 两句条件与请求相同，只是先后顺序不同。

english_and_references: It is a person who drives a bus. / It is someone whose job is to drive a bus.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 忘了“公交车司机”：描述开公交车的人。
context_and_translation: 第一句描述动作，第二句明确这是一份工作。

english_and_references: It is someone who cooks food as a job. / This person makes food for people at a restaurant.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 忘了“厨师”：描述以做饭为工作的人。
context_and_translation: 第一句说明职业；第二句以餐馆的工作场景帮助对方理解。

english_and_references: It is a person whose job is to take pictures. / This person uses a camera to take pictures for work.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 忘了“摄影师”：描述以拍照为工作的人。
context_and_translation: 两句都通过工作和工具解释；不是指每一个偶尔拍照的人。

english_and_references: It is the person who helps guests at hotel reception. / This person works at the front of the hotel and gives guests their room keys.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 忘了“前台接待员”：描述在酒店前台帮助客人的工作人员。
context_and_translation: 第一句用已知地点reception描述；第二句通过发房间钥匙的动作说明。

english_and_references: It is a small thing that you carry cash and cards in. / You keep your money and cards in it and carry it with you.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 忘了“钱包”：描述随身放现金和卡的小物品。
context_and_translation: 两句都说明用途；第一句也可能描述小卡包，可结合外形或指物补充。

english_and_references: You hold it above your head when it rains. / It is a thing you hold over your head to keep the rain off.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 忘了“伞”：描述下雨时举在头上方的物品。
context_and_translation: 两句通过持物的位置与挡雨用途解释，没有把其他防雨衣物说成伞。

english_and_references: It is a cloth you use to dry your hands or body. / You use this cloth to get water off your body after a shower.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 忘了“毛巾”：描述用来擦干手和身体的布。
context_and_translation: 第一句简洁说明材料和用途，第二句补充洗澡后的使用场景。

english_and_references: It is a machine that keeps food cold. / You put food in it to keep the food cold.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 忘了“冰箱”：描述让食物保持冷的机器。
context_and_translation: 第一句说明机器的功能，第二句从人的使用动作解释；未说冷冻所有食物。

english_and_references: It is a box that gets hot inside. You use it to cook food. / You put food inside it and use heat to cook the food.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 忘了“烤箱”：描述把食物放在里面加热烹饪的机器。
context_and_translation: 第一句用两个短句说明内部加热和做饭用途，第二句说明把食物放入并用热量烹饪的动作；可结合指物补充。

english_and_references: It is a machine that washes clothes. / You put dirty clothes in it, and it washes them.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 忘了“洗衣机”：描述清洗衣服的机器。
context_and_translation: 两句都明确清洗的对象是衣服，避免只说清洁机器而含混。

english_and_references: It is a small thing inside a phone that gives the phone power. / The phone gets power from this small thing inside it.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 忘了“电池”：描述给手机提供电力的小物品。
context_and_translation: 两句都说明这是手机内部提供电力的物品，与外接充电器区分。

english_and_references: It is the place in the wall where you put a plug to get power. / You put the plug in this place in the wall to get power.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 忘了“插座”：描述墙上让电器插头接电的地方。
context_and_translation: 两句都结合墙、插头和电力解释用途，不要求先说出socket。

english_and_references: It is a picture that shows roads and places. / You use this picture to find places and see which roads to take.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 忘了“地图”：描述显示道路和地点的图片。
context_and_translation: 第一句描述图片内容，第二句说明找路的用途。

english_and_references: It is the place at the station where you wait for a train. / You wait here at the station and get on the train here.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 忘了“站台”：描述在车站等待并上火车的地方。
context_and_translation: 两句都指定车站内等车和上车的位置，第二句补充上车动作。

english_and_references: It is the place at the airport where you wait to get on the plane. / At the airport, you go to this place before you get on your plane.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 忘了“登机口”：描述在机场等待登机的位置。
context_and_translation: 两句通过机场和登机流程描述，第二句更依赖眼前位置或指示牌。

english_and_references: It is a piece of paper that shows what you bought and how much you paid. / This paper shows the things you paid for and the amount you paid.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 忘了“收据”：描述显示买了什么、付了多少钱的纸。
context_and_translation: 两句都说明付款后的记录；不是尚未付款的账单。

english_and_references: You stand behind other people and wait for your turn. / People stand in a line and wait to go one at a time.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 忘了“排队”：描述站在其他人后面，等轮到自己。
context_and_translation: 第一句从个人动作说明，第二句描述一队人按顺序进行；不是挤在一起等。

english_and_references: It is a word or code you type to get into your account. / You type this word or code to use your account, and you keep it private.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 忘了“密码”：描述登录时输入、不能随便告诉别人的词或代码。
context_and_translation: 第一句说明用途，第二句补充保密；不把实际密码填写到练习中。

english_and_references: I will see the doctor at a time we agreed on. / The doctor and I agreed on a time to meet.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 忘了“预约”：说明你和医生约好了见面的时间。
context_and_translation: 两句都说明见面时间经过约定，第一句说明会去见医生，第二句强调双方约好的时间。

english_and_references: I want to pay to use a car for a few days and then give it back. / Can I pay to use this car for a few days and return it after that?
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 忘了“租车”：说明你想付钱使用一辆车几天，再把它还回去。
context_and_translation: 两句都含付钱、短期使用和归还，不是买车。

english_and_references: Can I use your pen and give it back after that? / May I use your pen? I will give it back.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 忘了“借用”：请求现在用一下对方的笔，之后归还。
context_and_translation: 两句都说明会归还；第一句合成一个请求，第二句分成两个短句。

english_and_references: I want to return this and get my money back. / Can I give this back and get back the money I paid?
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 忘了“退款”：说明你想退回买的物品并拿回钱。
context_and_translation: 两句都包含退物和退钱；不是只换另一个物品，也不保证商家接受。

english_and_references: Can you make the price lower? / Can I get this for less money?
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 忘了“折扣”：询问价格能不能低一些。
context_and_translation: 第一句请对方降价，第二句问能否少付一点；不要求说出discount。

english_and_references: This food makes my mouth feel hot. / My mouth feels hot when I eat this food.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 忘了“辣”：描述吃了以后嘴里有灼热感觉的食物。
context_and_translation: 这里说明辣的感受，不是说食物的温度高；必要时配合指物说明。

english_and_references: This bag keeps rain out and keeps the things inside dry. / The things inside this bag stay dry in the rain.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 忘了“防水”：说明这个包可以挡住雨水，不让里面的东西湿。
context_and_translation: 两句描述雨中防水效果，没有承诺可以长时间泡在水里。

english_and_references: The part of my phone that shows pictures and words is broken. / The part of my phone where I see words and pictures does not work.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 忘了“屏幕”：说明手机显示图片和文字的那部分坏了。
context_and_translation: 第一句说明显示图片文字的部件坏了；第二句从使用者看到文字图片的位置说明不能正常运作。

english_and_references: What day will it get here? / When can you get it to this place?
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 询问东西哪一天可以送到这里。
context_and_translation: 第一句指定询问到达的日子；第二句更宽泛地问何时能送达，需要时可继续确认具体日期。

english_and_references: Please come back tomorrow. / Can you come back tomorrow?
context_and_translation: 第一句直接礼貌请求，第二句以问题方式询问明天回来是否可行。

english_and_references: Please get ready to leave. / Can you get ready to go?
context_and_translation: get ready表示进入准备好的状态，不是拿一个叫ready的东西。

english_and_references: Can you give me an example? / Please show me an example.
context_and_translation: 第一句用give提出请求，第二句用show请求展示一个例子。

english_and_references: I need to go back to the hotel. / I need to return to the hotel.
context_and_translation: go back与return都表示返回；return本身已有回去的意思。

english_and_references: Please keep your passport safe. / Please keep your passport in a safe place.
context_and_translation: 第一句强调保持安全，第二句补充放在安全地方这个方法。

english_and_references: Please let me know the time. / Can you tell me the time?
context_and_translation: let me know在这里表示告诉我，不是允许我自己去找信息。

english_and_references: I need more time to make a choice. / I need more time to decide.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 说明你还需要时间作出选择。
context_and_translation: make a choice和decide都表示作决定，第一句使用名词组合。

english_and_references: Please put your phone away. / Please put your phone in your bag.
context_and_translation: 第一句不限定收在哪里；第二句明确放进包，只有适合时才选。

english_and_references: The phone seems to work now. / It seems that the phone works now.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 说明手机现在似乎能用了。
context_and_translation: 两句都保留似乎这一不确定程度，没有把印象说成已经确认。

english_and_references: Let us take a break. / Let us have a short rest.
context_and_translation: take a break是常用休息组合；第二句明确是短暂休息。口语也常用Let's。

english_and_references: Please be careful with this box. / Please move this box carefully.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 请对方小心搬这个盒子。
context_and_translation: 第一句用be说明需要的状态，第二句直接说明小心移动；carefully是方式词。

english_and_references: I will do my best to help. / I will try my best to help.
context_and_translation: 两句都承诺尽力，不是保证一定解决所有问题。

english_and_references: Can I have a look at the menu? / Can I see the menu?
context_and_translation: have a look表示看一看，不是拥有一个物品；第二句更简短。

english_and_references: I want to say thank you for your help. / Thank you for helping me. / Thanks for your help.
context_and_translation: 第一句完整说明想表达感谢，第二句是更直接自然的感谢。 也可用Thanks for your help简洁表达同一感谢。

english_and_references: I see what you mean. / I understand what you mean.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 告诉对方你明白他的意思了。
context_and_translation: see在这里表示明白，不是用眼睛看到。

english_and_references: Please send me a link to the website. / Can you send me the website link?
context_and_translation: 两句请求同一链接，第一句直接礼貌请求，第二句用Can you提问。

english_and_references: May I use your phone? / Can I use your phone, please?
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 礼貌询问能否使用对方的手机。
context_and_translation: May I通常较正式；Can I在日常请求许可时也自然，不把may解释成普通动作。

english_and_references: The room will be ready at two. / It will be possible to use the room at two.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 告诉对方房间两点会准备好。
context_and_translation: 第一句直接说明准备好的时间，第二句说明届时可以使用；都是对未来的说明。

english_and_references: Please say that again. / Can you repeat that, please?
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 请对方把刚才的话再说一次。
context_and_translation: 第一句用say again，第二句用repeat表达重复；不限定慢速。

english_and_references: There is a shower in the room. / The room has a shower.
chinese_prompt_or_meaning: 说明房间里有淋浴设施。
context_and_translation: 第一句以There is说明某处有，第二句以房间为主题说明设施。
